Agent.description: An LLM agent loop with tools and optional context block.

durable.description:
Optional durable-execution config (ADR-0053). `None` => not
durable (whole-bundle reentrant only). `Some` opts the agent into
turn-level checkpoint/resume. `skip_serializing_if` keeps
non-durable agents byte-stable with pre-A-minimal modules.

model_ref.description: Resolved model selection (backend + vendor id), baked at lowering.

output_schema.description:
Optional JSON schema describing the agent's structured output.
Plumbed from `[agents.<id>].output_schema`. The judge-compat
build-time check (Issue #470) runs at the authoring-config layer
(`validate_postconditions` in `tau-pkg`), comparing this schema
against downstream `schema_valid` goals before lowering.
`skip_serializing_if` keeps schema-less agents byte-stable.

produces.description: Artifact loci this agent declares it produces (deliverable binding).

prompt.description:
System prompt source: an inline literal or a content-addressed asset
reference (D6-B). `Inline` serializes as a bare string, keeping pre-2.5
modules byte-stable.

tool_refs.description: Tools this agent is allowed to call.

max_tokens.description:
Maximum tokens (input + output) the agent may consume across the
entire run. `None` defers.

max_turns.description:
Maximum number of turns the agent loop may take. `None` defers
to the runtime default.

AgentId.description: Identifier for an [`crate::Agent`] node within a [`crate::Workflow`].

AssetRef.description:
A content-addressed reference to a bundle asset.

A distinct `deny_unknown_fields` struct (rather than an inline
`Asset { asset }` variant) so the generated JSON Schema emits
`additionalProperties: false` and rejects stray keys in the asset object.

Backoff.description:
Backoff parameters. Durations are stored as the author's verbatim
duration strings (e.g. `"30s"`, `"10m"`) — they are host-honoured
metadata, not values the (no_std) IR interpreter ever computes with.

max.description: Cap on the computed delay, duration string (e.g. `"10m"`).

oneOf.description: Constant delay between attempts.
Exponentially increasing delay, capped at `Backoff::max`.

CapabilityRequirements.description:
The capability-requirement set for one tool.

Re-export shape over `Vec<tau_domain::Capability>` — the IR does not
re-define what a capability *is*; it just carries the existing type
across the boundary. Future evolution (capability narrowing in the IR
pre-hash, etc.) lands here.

declared.description:
Declared capabilities; order is taken from the source TOML verbatim
(capability list order is taken from the source TOML verbatim; two
permuted capability arrays produce different canonical bytes. If
order-independent hashing becomes required, sort in the lowering
parse stage — `Capability` needs `Ord` first.)

CapabilityTable.description:
Per-tool capability table for a `Workflow`.

Built by the lowering pass from per-tool TOML declarations; consumed
by the capability-fit check (D-3b) and embedded in the bundle's
`tau.caps` custom section (D-3).

Check.description: A postcondition evaluated at a point in the pipeline.

oneOf.description: Deterministic predicate over a read locus.
Produced artifact whose content an LLM judge evaluates.

CheckpointGranularity.description:
Checkpoint granularity.

A-minimal ships `PerTurn` (commit after each completed turn,
at-least-once for the crashed turn) and `PerToolCall` (narrower
at-least-once window within a turn). Finer granularities are additive.

oneOf.description: Commit a checkpoint after each completed turn.

Commit a checkpoint after each completed tool call within a turn.
Narrows (does not close) the at-least-once window — exactly-once
stays A-full's job. Resume re-dispatches only the tools that had
not completed before the crash (ADR-0053 follow-up).

Condition.description:
A deterministic predicate over a read locus — the condition for a
`Branch`/`Loop` (EPIC 4.1) and structurally identical to the goal arm of a
`Check` (`CheckVerify::Goal`).

predicate.description: The predicate applied to the locus.

ContextConfig.description:
β.4 context-manager configuration attached to an [`crate::node::Agent`].

`None` on the agent means "no context management" (full history every
turn — pre-β.4 behavior). An empty `pipeline` serializes to `{}` so a
`Some(ContextConfig::default())` is byte-identical to the legacy empty
placeholder.

pipeline.description:
Ordered transformers, applied top-to-bottom each turn. The last
step must be the builtin `fit_budget` (typecheck-enforced).

ContextNodeKind.description: Delivery vehicle for a context node.

oneOf.description: A tau-provided builtin transformer.

A user-supplied node resolved at runtime. `source` selects the lane.

See: [escape-hatches.md#contextnodekind-custom](../../docs/explanation/escape-hatches.md#contextnodekind-custom).

ContextStep.description: One node in a context pipeline.

determinism.description:
Author-declared determinism class. Gates β.6 conformance and what
`TransformCx` exposes at runtime.

kind.description: Whether this is a builtin or a user-supplied custom node.

transformer.description:
Transformer name. For builtins: `trim_old`, `compact_tool_outputs`,
`fit_budget`. For custom nodes: the user-chosen step name.

DeterminismClass.description:
Determinism class shared by the IR (this enum) and the runtime trait
(`tau_runtime_core::context::ContextTransformer::determinism`).
Defined here so both crates use one definition (no drift).

oneOf.description: Pure function of (messages, config); v1's three transformers.
Calls an `LlmBackend` (β.4.3); conformance-gated via cassette replay.
Reads/writes a memory store (β.4.4); excluded from the conformance gate.

fn_ref.description: Reference to the statically linked Rust function.

Durability.description:
Durable-execution config attached to an [`crate::node::Agent`].

Either a high-level **intent** (the host picks granularity + store per
target — EPIC 6.1) or the **explicit** A-minimal form (ADR-0053).
Absent (`None` on the agent) is byte-stable with pre-A-minimal modules.

oneOf.description:
High-level intent. The host resolves it to a concrete granularity +
store for the run/build target (see `tau_runtime_core::durable_resolve`).
Explicit escape hatch: the author names the mechanism directly.

checkpoint.description: How often a checkpoint is committed.

DurabilityIntent.description:
High-level durability intent. The host sizes it per target.

`#[non_exhaustive]`: more intents are additive `MINOR` `ir_format` bumps.

oneOf.description:
"This run must survive a process restart." Resolves per target to the
coarsest checkpoint + store the target can durably provide.

DurableStore.description:
Where durable state is written.

A-minimal ships only `File` (`./.tau/runs/<run_id>/turn-<n>.json`).
`Kv` (an MCP-contracted journal — never a built-in DB, per NG6) is an
additive follow-up belonging to A-full.

oneOf.description: Per-turn snapshot files under `.tau/runs/<run_id>/`.

DynamicSpawn.description:
One spawnable per-kind agent definition inside a [`StepRun::Dynamic`]
region, resolved with its capability grant so the runtime gate
(EPIC 4.5) is self-contained (no re-resolution against `tau.toml`).

EPIC 4.5 makes this a runnable template: alongside the capability grant
it also carries everything the runtime gate needs to actually spawn a
child agent (description, prompt, resolved model, tool allow-list) —
no re-resolution against `tau.toml` at spawn time.

tool_refs.description: Tool ids the spawned child may call.

oneOf.description: Locus resolves.
Resolves and non-empty.
Equals the literal.
Matches the regex.
At least N items.
Validates against the JSON schema.
Registered native fn.

IrFormatVersion.description:
Semver-shaped IR format version (D-6).

Bumps follow semver rules:
- MAJOR for breaking shape changes (removed node type, removed
  required field, changed lowering contract).
- MINOR for additive changes (new optional field, new variant of a
  `#[non_exhaustive]` enum).
- PATCH for spec-only edits with no IR-shape effect.

oneOf.description: The canonical judge, on a build-time-resolved model.

model_ref.description: Resolved model (alias resolved + producer-default applied at lowering).

oneOf.description: A user `[agents.*]` used as judge.
Filesystem path.
Named pipeline-step output (`steps.<id>.output`).

backend.description: Backend package name — the key the runtime resolves a backend by.

NativeFnRef.description:
A reference to a statically linked native tool by symbolic name.

The symbolic name (e.g. `"ReadTemp"`) is the Rust identifier of the
`impl Tool for X` type. The lowering pass resolves it against the
project's native tool registry; AOT (β.7) lowers the call site
directly. v0's interpreter dispatches by name through a
`NativeFnRegistry` injected at runtime.

name.description: Symbolic name of the Rust `Tool` impl.

oneOf.description: Exit non-zero with the rationale.
Rewind to the gate and re-run forward.

Pipeline.description: An ordered, engine-sequenced pipeline of steps.

steps.description: Steps, executed top-to-bottom in this order.

id.description:
Handle for this step; its output is addressable as
`steps.<id>.output` by later steps.

PipelineStepId.description:
Identifier for a [`crate::pipeline::PipelineStep`] within a
[`crate::Workflow`]'s pipeline. Addressable as `steps.<id>.output`.

anyOf.description: A literal system prompt. On the wire: a bare JSON string.

A content-addressed reference into the bundle's asset store.
On the wire: `{"asset":"sha256:<64 hex>"}`.

PromptSource.description:
Where an agent's system prompt comes from.

`#[serde(untagged)]` keeps `Inline` on the wire as a bare string —
byte-identical to the pre-2.5 `prompt: String` field.

gate.description: Rewind point — at or before the producer step.

RetryPolicy2.description:
Trigger-level re-invocation policy. This is **not** a per-node interpreter
retry: the host (or host adapter) re-invokes the artifact; tau's
interpreter stays deterministic and stateless across invocations.

dead_letter.description:
Where a run that exhausts `max_attempts` is sent — a **sink
reference** (`mcp:<name>` or an already-granted capability target),
never a tau-owned queue. `None` ⇒ no dead-letter sink. The envelope
shape is a runtime concern not modelled in slice 1 (see ADR-0044 §D2).

max_attempts.description: Total attempts including the first; `1` = no retry.

StepId.description: Identifier for a [`crate::Deterministic`] step within a [`crate::Workflow`].

StepRun.description: What a [`PipelineStep`] executes — a reference to an existing node.

oneOf.description: Run an agent node by id.
Invoke a tool node by id.
Run a deterministic step node by id.

Evaluate a postcondition check by id.

The referenced [`CheckId`](crate::ids::CheckId) must exist in
`workflow.checks`; this is enforced by the typecheck stage.
Runtime evaluation is implemented in `tau-runtime-core`'s
pipeline executor (Task 19).

EPIC 4.1: run `then` if `on` holds, else `otherwise` (may be empty).
Executed by the interpreter in 4.2.

otherwise.description: Steps run when `on` does not hold (may be empty).

oneOf.description:
EPIC 4.1: fork `branches`, run concurrently, join. Bounded fork-join
(concurrency capped by the interpreter, 4.2).

branches.description: Independent step sequences run in parallel.

oneOf.description:
EPIC 4.1: run `body` until `until` holds or `max_iters` is hit
(mandatory bound — no unbounded loops). Reuses `OnFail::Retry` rewind
in the interpreter (4.2).

max_iters.description: Hard iteration cap (`> 0`, enforced by typecheck).

oneOf.description:
EPIC 4.1: human-in-the-loop pause — checkpoint and wait for
`resume_signal`, then seed-and-skip resume (ADR-0053 `per_tool_call`
checkpoint; round-trip in 4.3).

resume_signal.description: Signal name that resumes the run.

oneOf.description:
EPIC 4.4/4.5: a bounded dynamic region. The interpreter runs `owner`
(the region's coordinator agent) with one `agent.<kind>.spawn` tool
registered per offered kind in `spawns`. Each spawn is admitted
against the region's `max_spawns`/`max_concurrency` bounds counters
— pooled across every offered kind, not per-kind — and, once
admitted, attenuated to the meet of `envelope` and the spawned
kind's declared capabilities before its child agent runs. A spawn
past bounds is a soft denial: the coordinator receives an
`is_error` tool result describing the exhausted bound and the
run continues. Build-time verified: every spawn ⊆ envelope ⊆
owner ⊆ root `[allow]` (see `tau check governance`).

envelope.description: Region capability envelope (ceiling); every spawn ⊆ this.

max_concurrency.description: Hard cap on concurrent spawns (`0 < n <= max_spawns`).

max_spawns.description: Hard cap on total spawns (`> 0`, enforced at author time).

owner.description:
The coordinator agent that runs the region — must exist in
`workflow.agents` (typechecked).

spawns.description: Spawnable per-kind agent definitions this region may launch.

SubflowEdge.description: A subflow edge in a workflow.

id.description: Identifier of this subflow within the workflow.

SubflowId.description: Identifier for a [`crate::Subflow`] edge within a [`crate::Workflow`].

oneOf.description:
Spawn a sibling agent within the same module with a narrowed
capability set. Per the subset-of-parent rule, `cap_subset`
MUST be a subset of the parent agent's grant; the lowering pass
checks this.

cap_subset.description: Capability subset granted to the child.

oneOf.description:
Compose another full workflow as a subroutine. Used for
pipeline composition; v0 reserves the variant but the lowering
pass currently rejects it pending the multi-workflow framing
in a future spec.

capabilities.description:
Declared capabilities. Used by the capability-fit check (D-3b),
the governance ceiling check, and — at runtime — the subflow
attenuation gate (`AttenuatedDispatcher`). NOT consulted by the
kernel's per-tool dispatch-site gate: `DispatcherTool` deliberately
reports no required caps because the IR carries no per-agent grant
to check them against (issue #581).

impl_.description: How the tool's behavior is provided.

spec.description:
Tool specification (name, description, input schema) used by the
LLM to decide when to call the tool.

ToolId.description: Identifier for a [`crate::Tool`] node within a [`crate::Workflow`].

ToolImpl.description: How a [`crate::Tool`] node's behavior is provided at runtime.

oneOf.description: Statically linked native tool.

content_hash.description:
Hash of the impl's source bytes (Rust source, dependencies'
content hashes). Participates in the IR module hash.

fn_ref.description: Reference to the native Rust impl by symbolic name.

oneOf.description: MCP-contracted external server.

capability_subset.description:
The subset of capabilities this MCP server is bounded to (a
subset of the contract's declared capabilities; narrowed by
`tau.toml` overrides).

contract_hash.description:
Content hash of the MCP contract (the cached schema + capability
declaration the server advertises at handshake). Participates in
the IR module hash so a contract drift invalidates the bundle.

server_tool_name.description:
The name passed on the MCP wire (server-side tool name).
Differs from this `Tool` node's `ToolId` because lowering
expands one author-side entry (`weather`) into N IR nodes
(`weather.get_forecast`, `weather.get_current`, ...); each
expanded node carries the server-side name to forward on
`tools/call` requests.

oneOf.description:
Sub-workflow spawn: invoking this tool runs the named agent (in the
same `IrModule`) as a child loop with empty initial history. The
child's final assistant text (or empty string) becomes the tool
result body.

v0 limitation: tool input args are NOT forwarded to the child as a
User message — the child runs with empty initial messages and its
own prompt + LLM script drive its behavior. β.7 (AOT codegen) is
the natural place to thread arg-forwarding.

Deterministic step: invoking this tool calls the pure Rust function
named by the step's `fn_ref` via the dispatcher's
`deterministic_registry()`. The function's return value becomes the
tool result body. No LLM, no I/O.

ToolSpec.description:
Tool specification surface used by the agent loop.

Mirror of `tau_ports::ToolSpec` adapted for IR storage. Provides the
LLM-facing schema; not used for capability decisions.

input_schema.description: JSON schema for the tool's input.

TriggerBinding.description:
One named trigger binding. Canonically ordered by `name` within
`IrModule.triggers`. A trigger is metadata about how tau is invoked,
never an executable node.

Optional fields serialize verbatim (`None` → `null`, no skipping) to
match the IR's canonical-encoding discipline (see `canonical.rs`). Only
the module-level `triggers` `Vec` skips-when-empty, to preserve
trigger-less hashes.

agent.description: Entrypoint agent id (validated at lowering against the workflow).

kind.description: The kind of event this binds to.

retry.description: Re-invocation policy (`None` = invoke once, no retry).

timezone.description:
IANA timezone name; defaults to `"UTC"` at config-validation time
(cron kind only).

TriggerKind.description: The kind of external event a trigger binds to.

oneOf.description: Fires on a cron schedule. Substrate = systemd/k8s/Lambda scheduler.

The default: tau is invoked by an external driver (a parent process,
CI step, etc.). No scheduler descriptor is emitted.

Workflow.description: The set of nodes + edges that make up one workflow.

capability_table.description:
Per-tool capability requirements. Derived from `tools` but
stored explicitly for the bundle's `tau.caps` custom section.

checks.description:
Postcondition checks, keyed by id. Positioned in the pipeline via
`StepRun::Check`.

pipeline.description:
Optional engine-sequenced pipeline. `None` preserves single-entry
behavior (run the named entry agent). `Some` => `run_pipeline`.

description:
The container for one workflow's IR.

`tau build` emits one `IrModule` per workflow (one per project for
v0). `tau verify --bundle` re-builds and asserts byte-equality of
the canonical form (D-6).

target.description: Target triple this module was lowered for.

tau_version.description:
Version of the `tau-ir-lower` crate that emitted this module (stamped
from its `CARGO_PKG_VERSION` at lowering). Workspace-versioned, so it
equals the `tau` CLI binary version today. Semver-shaped (e.g. `"0.X.Y"`).

triggers.description:
Trigger bindings — invocation metadata, a SIBLING of `workflow`
(triggers are about *how* tau is invoked, not the call graph).
`skip_serializing_if` + `default` means a trigger-less module emits
no `triggers` key and hashes identically to a pre-trigger module
(Option B / ADR-0044 §D1); older modules with no key read back as empty.
